overview.about: The Zurich Classic of New Orleans is the PGA Tour's only team event, pairing two professionals who alternate between foursomes and fourball formats over four days at TPC Louisiana. The relaxed, team-based twist makes it one of the most distinctive weeks of the season.
overview.nextEvent: The next Zurich Classic is played at TPC Louisiana in Avondale, just outside New Orleans. Teams of two combine for a mix of alternate-shot and best-ball golf, with the pairings often producing star duos.

stayGuidance: A base in Avondale shortens the final leg to TPC Louisiana; New Orleans gives more accommodation and visitor services with a longer transfer.
bookingAdvice: Compare total price, cancellation terms and the route to the course before committing to tournament-week travel.
